# AI Voiceover Studio

> AI Voiceover Studio (`ai-voiceover-studio`, command `voiceover`) is an open-source MIT-licensed Python 3.9+ CLI and library that turns a written script into an AI voiceover: text to speech, multi-speaker narration, voice cloning from a reference clip, SRT subtitles and simple faceless slideshow videos for YouTube, Shorts and explainers. Miragea (https://miragea.ai) is the built-in remote voice engine; other engines plug in through a small provider interface, and an offline dummy engine enables dry runs without an API key.

Key facts:
- Install: `pip install -e .` from the repository (extras: `[video]` for moviepy, `[yaml]` for voices.yaml). Core has zero third-party dependencies; ffmpeg is used for MP3 and burned-in captions when installed.
- Configure: `MIRAGEA_API_KEY` (create at https://miragea.ai/workspace/api), optional `MIRAGEA_BASE_URL` (default https://miragea.ai/v1).
- Commands: `voiceover say "text" --voice <actor_id|reference-audio-url> -o out.mp3`; `voiceover script script.md --voices voices.json -o out/`; `voiceover voices`; `voiceover video --images dir/ --script script.md -o video.mp4`; `voiceover task <id> --wait`. `--dry-run` uses the offline engine; `--json` gives machine-readable output.
- Script format: `[SPEAKER]: text` lines in Markdown/TXT, untagged lines continue the speaker, `[pause 1.5]` inserts silence, `[SPEAKER](tags=a|b, speed=1.1): ...` sets per-line options.
- Outputs: one audio track, an SRT file (from segment timing by default, or speech recognition), per-segment WAV cache and manifest.json.
- Reliability: async task polling, deterministic Idempotency-Key per request, retries only on retryable errors, clear 401/403/409/413/429 messages, API key never printed or stored.
- Languages (Miragea engine): Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Russian, Portuguese, Spanish, Italian.
- Agent skill for Claude Code / Codex / Cursor: skills/ai-voiceover/SKILL.md.
